verdict.rationale: Cline documents headless autonomous runs inside GitHub Actions, GitLab or any pipeline, and its auto-approve mode can run tests and fix failures without prompts. This covers a remotely run agent that builds and tests a feature. However, Cline offers no first-party hosted cloud agent, and nothing shows it producing a demo artifact for review; diff review is documented only in the local IDE and Kanban. Missing for 10: a vendor-hosted cloud agent environment, demo artifacts (screenshots, video or preview links) handed back for review, an end-to-end build-test-demo-review workflow in the cloud, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review

citations.quote: Run it headlessly inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline.
Autonomous execution can modify files and run commands without further prompts.
cline --auto-approve true "run tests and fix failures"
Long-running dev servers, tests, deploys, all handled live.
